Messrs [Harper](../persons.html#248)
I am much obliged for the [£10](../others.html#160) for [Love and Life](../books.html#137) received on the 14th yesterday. I am also much obliged to you for sending me your ‘[paper for young people](../others.html#250).’[^1] I ventured to extract a short poem on the Plumes of Crecy for a [Reading Book for schools](../books.html#150) making however a few alterations to bring it more into accordance with history than romance[^2]
Yours faithfully
C.M.

Yonge

[^1]: There is a pencil line beside the mention of the reading book and ‘Is not this worth mention?’ written in pencil.

Underneath, in ink ‘Attended to./ S.S.C.’

[^2]: Lillie E.

Barr, ‘The Plumes of Creçy’ was included in [English History Reading Books](../books.html#150) III, 106-9, with a note ‘in Harper’s Young People (slightly altered)’. CMY has reciprocated the American [piracy](../others.html#172) of her work.
